summary: Spec Ops entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Spec Ops: The Line
entries.definitive_edition: Legally owned final PC build; no current normal digital storefront route

emulation.emulator: RPCS3/Xenia only for console preservation comparison
emulation.notes: Native owned PC route is preferred.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Final owned PC build at documented settings

primary.version: Legally owned final PC build after 2024 digital delisting
primary.why: The PC route has the best capture/settings ceiling, but the game was removed from digital storefronts in 2024 because partnership licenses expired. Existing owners and physical copies are the practical archive route; new normal digital purchase is not available.
primary.how_to_play: Use a legally owned PC copy from an existing Steam/GOG/library install or physical media. Record storefront/disc, build, language, region, controller, graphics settings, DLC/preorder content, and delisting/current ownership state.

secondary.what_to_play: Use only for console-performance or preservation comparison.
secondary.why: PC remains the best capture route when a legal owned copy is available.

entries.remaster_caveats: Document delisting status and do not list as normally purchasable.
